threads.body: This clarifies how to record provider-executed tool outcomes, but no reference scenario demonstrates that mapping as required for convention changes. The OpenAI scenario only supplies `web_search` as a tool definition, and the Anthropic scenario records text output only. Please extend either scenario to read a built-in tool outcome from an SDK response and emit it as `server_tool_call_response`.

replies.body:
This PR changes no field, attribute or signal. It removes "or a built-in tool call outcome and details" from `ToolCallResponsePart`'s description, and validation is unchanged. The guidance to use `server_tool_call_response` for built-in tools already exists, from open-telemetry/semantic-conventions#3038.

No scenario emits the server tool parts today, so that gap predates this PR. I'd cover it separately.
